result.summary: The page structure is mostly sound, but the second 'Popular right now' card is missing its title/metadata block, the bottom navigation bar contains a stray full-width dark bar overlapping its icons, and there are styling inconsistencies between favorite buttons and card thumbnails.

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' (the pizza card) shows only its image — the restaurant name, rating, delivery time/fee and cuisine line are absent, even though there is blank space below the image before the bottom navigation.
issues.suggestion: Render the same info block (name, rating, ETA, delivery fee, cuisine) used by the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, or verify the data binding for this list item.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar has a long dark horizontal bar stretching across the middle (through the search/bookmark icons), which looks like a mis-sized or overlapping element rather than an intentional indicator; it also visually collides with the bookmark/search glyphs.
issues.suggestion: Remove or correctly size the stray element (e.g., constrain the active-tab indicator to the width of a single tab) so nav icons render cleanly and evenly spaced.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled differently: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second has a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite-button style across all cards.

issues.description: In 'Fastest near you', the first card (Green Bowl Poké) uses a light grey image background while the neighboring cards use dark backgrounds, making the row look visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail treatment (same aspect ratio, background/overlay) so badges and images read consistently across the carousel.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons have no text labels, so their purpose is unclear and they may lack accessible names.
issues.suggestion: Add visible labels (Home, Search, Orders, Profile) and accessible labels/roles for screen readers.
